blocks.text:
Today the route takes you beyond Belize: you will travel to Guatemala to visit Tikal, one of the great ancient Maya cities. During the guided tour, you will see the temples and other structures in the complex and learn more about Maya civilisation.

Lunch and entrance fees are included in the programme. Border fees are paid separately. After the tour, return to San Ignacio.

**Meals:** breakfast, lunch.
